inputs_sent.prompt: A locked-off closer shot of a wooden desk in a bedroom at night. The camera is fixed and never moves. An open laptop on the desk glows soft white. After a moment the screen glows brighter, and a small, soft, rounded mint character with the app's face pushes out through the glowing screen as if through a doorway of light, climbs out over the keyboard, hops down onto the desk beside the laptop, turns to the camera and lifts one tiny arm in a small, cheerful hello. Its soft glow lights the desk. Playful, smooth motion, like a premium 3D animated brand film. Nothing spooky.
